notes: SHIFTING GROUND - every WAR! battle rolls a fresh field: the hives nest somewhere new along the far side, the debris scatters fresh, and lines of indestructible barrier slabs stand in new places with a gap rolled into every line - your army pathfinds through, and so do the bugs. Save & Quit is fixed on the world map: the region holding your parked battle is marked IN PROGRESS, tapping it resumes the fight exactly where you left it, and no fresh battle can quietly overwrite the one you parked.
